_why: Regression corpus for test/fuzz/builder-fuzz.test.ts. See ../corpus.ts for the two entry kinds and how to add one (PG_PRIME_FUZZ_RECORD=1).

cases.note: mutation seed for the SET-OPERATION half of the json class: a setop shape whose two branches each carry a relation column, joined with `intersect`. Shipped code plans both branches with rowEquality and emits jsonb_agg; with compile/hoist.ts's jsonVariant switch removed it is 42883. The `found` seeds below all reach the class through `.distinct()`, so without this one the operator half of it is pinned by nothing.

found on the first live run: .distinct() with an orderBy on a column the random projection did not include is 42P10 `for SELECT DISTINCT, ORDER BY expressions must appear in select list`. FIXED 2026-08-27 — the builder now refuses it at compile time with a sentence naming the expression (compile/compiler.ts's checkDistinctOrder), so this seed is a chain the fuzzer records as `refused` and never sends to the server.

found on the first live run: .distinct() over a projection carrying a `many` relation is 42883 `could not identify an equality operator for type json`. FIXED 2026-08-27 — a relation column under a statement that compares whole rows is built as jsonb (compile/hoist.ts's jsonVariant), so this seed now plans and executes.

mutation seed for the DISTINCT ON ordering class, which had no pinned seed of its own: a chain whose `orderBy(posts)` step was drawn BEFORE its `distinctOn` step, so the keys are not the initial ORDER BY expressions. Shipped code leads the emitted ORDER BY with them (compile/hoist.ts's alignDistinctOn); with that removed it is 42P10. The class needs ~5 000 live cases to reappear by chance, which is how it was found and why a pin is worth more here than anywhere else in this file.

the json/distinct class again, 5 000 live cases later: the first fix listed `many` and the two nested shapes as the json-projecting relation accessors and missed `all()`. Pinned because it is the seed that proved a partial fix is a fix that comes back. FIXED 2026-08-27 with 2802423309, by a rule that is about the STATEMENT rather than about a list of accessors — which is why the same class cannot return through a seventh spelling.
